articles.title: Konami Partners With Celebrity Kitty to Release Metal Gear Cat Toys at CatCon 2026
articles.summary: Konami is partnering up with a celebrity kitty named ‘one-eared Uno’ to debut a special Metal Gear cat toy collection available at CatCon 2026. If you didn’t know there was a cat convention, now you do.
body: One of those cats, affectionately named ‘one-eared Uno,’ and her owner, Kat Curtis, will host a special meet-and-greet event at the Konami booth at CatCon this year to celebrate the release of some special Metal Gear-themed cat toys.

These offerings include cat scratch boxes modeled after the iconic cardboard boxes that Big Boss and Old Snake use to sneak around without being detected by enemies, plush pet toys, and even cat collars inspired by Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots.

The lovable one-eared Uno with her adorable underbite was rescued by Kat as a stray, who found the kitty abandoned near a dumpster. The two now boast over five million followers on social media and are meeting fans at Catcon on October 12 at 2 PM PST.

CatCon takes place at the Pasadena Convention Center from October 10 - 11. Cat lovers will be able to score the Snake-approved merch for their kitties on those days only, both at the convention and online via the OKS Gear Shop.
points: Konami is partnering up with a celebrity kitty named ‘one-eared Uno’ to debut a special Metal Gear cat toy collection available at CatCon 2026.

articles.title: For Today Only, Best Buy Has a 5TB Seagate Portable Hard Drive for $169.99
articles.summary: For today only, Best Buy is offering a rare deal on a portable hard drive. The Seagate "Game Drive for Xbox" 5TB USB 3.2 Portable Hard Drive is on sale for $169.99 with free shipping after a $50 instant discount. It's sold and shipped by Newegg, an authorized Seagate reseller.
body: Just to clear up any confusion: although this drive is marketed as a "Game Drive for Xbox," this is simply a standard portable hard drive with Xbox licensing and a green LED bar that matches the Xbox motif. The drive boasts real world transfers of up to 100-150MB/s over USB 3.2. Probably the most annoying feature of this drive is that it has a USB 3.0 Micro-B connection, which isn't very common. Fortunately, a USB Micro-B to USB Type-A cable is provided. It you lose it, you're unlikely to have a spare and will probably need to buy a new one. A 1 year warranty is included.

articles.title: Gravhounds Reveal Trailer Sends Good Boys Into A Sci-Fi Battle
articles.summary: Gamescom Opening Night Live is always full of surprises, and this year, indie developer Octopus Panic made a splash with a first look at its new action-builder game Gravhounds.
body: Although the trailer states that the titular Gravhounds have been "bred" for this life, their humanoid appearance suggests more than a little genetic engineering was responsible for this turn of events. In fact, there's no sign of human life at all on this hostile alien world, but the Gravhounds themselves seem human enough.

The gameplay supports 1-4 players as they attempt to build up resources for a new colony while holding on to the potential promise of coming home. Upgrades appear to play a major role in the main characters' survival, especially when they get overwhelmed by alien forces that really don't want them around at all.

According to Gravhounds' Steam page, the game's early-access period will last at least six months. It will "include the core Gravhound experience," but we plan to expand its breadth, depth, and replayability on the road to 1.0," reads the statement. Both solo and co-op campaigns will be playable during this initial release.
Gravhounds' early-access release will hit Xbox Series X|S and PC on November 2. It will also be available on day one with Xbox Game Pass.

articles.title: This LEGO Gift Card Deal Can Save You $65 on the Massive Minas Tirith Set
articles.summary: There have been some really cool new LEGO sets in 2026 so far. Naturally, many of the most amazing builds are LEGO Exclusives that will almost certainly never be discounted directly.
body: There are sometimes ways to get indirect discounts on LEGO sets, though. Giftcards.com is currently running a promotion that saves you 10% on LEGO eGift cards for a limited time. There doesn't appear to be a limit and the gift cards can be used to buy anything from the online LEGO Store. Though it's absolutely worth noting that only three gift cards can be used at once.

This deal was first spotted by IGN's LEGO editor Chris Reed. He tested the promo code at various price points and there doesn't seem to be any sort of limit to how high you can go and still get that 10% off. That being said, you can only enter amounts up to $250 and there does appear to be a limit of 50 gift cards. With all that said, how much you save with this deal depends on how much you're willing to spend.

If you're hoping to use this discount to buy the LEGO Minas Tirith set, you will need to do a bit of math to stay at that three gift card limit. Thankfully, the website lets you do pretty much any custom amount. The quickest way to get to the price of the set is to buy three gift cards for $216.66 and apply the promo code.

articles.title: Apple's 2nd Generation AirTags Drop to a New Price Low
articles.summary: Apple's infinitely versatile AirTag just dropped to the lowest price I've seen. Amazon currently has the four-pack of Apple AirTags Gen 2 keyfinders for just $79.99 shipped, or just $20 per AirTag.
body: The Apple Airtag is a small coin-shaped device that you can put in your wallet or attach to your phones, keys, remote, or anything small enough to be easily misplaced. It works as a little Wi-Fi keyfinder that helps locate your lost objects by pinging its general location to your iPhone using Bluetooth 5.0. However, if your iPhone model has a U1 chip with Ultra Wideband, then you can take advantage of the "Precision Finding" mode. This gives you numerical distance and direction guidance when your lost item is close by. It points you right to it.

The second generation model is an iterative upgrade over its predecessor. It features more powerful Precision Finding, longer Bluetooth range, and a louder speaker. Fortunately the CR2032 coin battery is still user-replaceable, so your AirTag won't end up in a landfill when the battery depletes, nor will you have to deal with battery degradation like you would with a non-replaceable lithium battery.

articles.title: 'The Dog Stars Review: Ridley Scott's New Sci-Fi Odyssey Is an Action Movie Like No Other
articles.summary: Quiet, contemplative moments like these keep The Dog Stars grounded and accessible throughout its sprawling post-apocalyptic story — even as director Ridley Scott piles on epic action set pieces and surreal, surprising sequences that sometimes push the film from prestige drama into absurdist…
body: Hig pilots his small, vintage plane up into the Colorado mountains, cuts the engine, and glides. Surrounded by endless sky and soft green forest, there’s a look of uneasy peace on the young man’s face. Serenity, grief, and a glimmer of a death wish swirl together against the canvas of Jacob Elordi’s perpetual 5 o'clock shadow as he soars silently through the air, waiting until the last possible minute to restart the engine and fly back home.

In The Dog Stars, based on the 2012 book of the same name by Peter Heller and adapted by screenwriter Mark L. Smith ( The Revenant ), Elordi’s Hig is one of the few remaining survivors on Earth, years after a deadly virus swept the planet. He lives on an old airfield with a former marine named Bangley (Josh Brolin). All things considered, they have a pretty good life — plenty of whiskey, cigarettes, bullets, and the safety of a secure perimeter — but Hig wants something more.

articles.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation Gamescom Trailer Is All About The Weapons
articles.summary: Following its official reveal at Summer Games Fest, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation made another appearance at Gamescom Opening Night Live, following a brief introduction from director Naoki Hamaguchi.
body: The cinematic trailer showed Rufus Shinra giving an address following recent world events, and the world has become overrun with Weapons. Those kaiju-like beasts were a part of the original Final Fantasy 7, including as optional bosses, but they seem to have a much bigger role in the story here. In dialogue the cast talks about them being guardians of the planet, and humans are seen as a harmful invasive species. The trailer showed off Ultima Weapon and Emerald Weapon in particular, but there may be more.

The trailer also showed off a good bit of the full cast, an aerial battle in Cid's Highwind, and ground battles against familiar Final Fantasy foes like Typhon (aka Mr. Chupon, for you old-school fans).

articles.title: Steam's Most Intriguing Slow-Burn Adventure Game Takes 400 Real-World Days to Finish
articles.summary: Somewhere on your hard drive, a small, wide-eyed creature named Shade will keep standing alone in the dark, waiting on a ticking timer to go down, whether you’re there, watching as well, or not.
body: The intimacy this game offers is both eerie and surreal. You’ll find yourself with a new appreciation for your surroundings and how they shift over time. The “idle” half of the game does precisely what it promises: Assign Shade a task, close the game entirely, and, next time you check in, whether it’s a day or a month later, he’ll have completed it. Keep the game open while you’re accomplishing other things in your real-life space, and Shade will sit down on the cave floor and keep you company, occasionally muttering to himself about the water dripping nearby.

As one might expect for a unique game like this, the reception is mixed. Steam’s reviews for it currently sit at a Very Positive, and many people absolutely love this game. Some even restart the whole 400-day clock from scratch after drifting away for too long, unable to shake the feeling that they'd abandoned Shade and couldn’t simply pick back up where they left off. Others wonder what the point of this game is. One critic called The Longing “ Animal Crossing: Depressing Edition.” Depending on who you are and what you’re looking for in a gaming experience, that could be a compliment or a warning label. Your choice.

articles.title: The 5 Most Unforgettable Moments of Critical Role Campaign 4 So Far
articles.summary: Critical Role Campaign 4 has been an emotional rollercoaster since it debuted in October 2025. There have been epic battles, incredible game-shattering moments, shenanigans involving bikinis made out of souls, and, as expected in a Dungeons & Dragons campaign, plenty of death.
body: To celebrate Arc 2 of Campaign 4 set to premiere this Thursday night, we’ve rounded up five of the best, biggest, and wildest moments of Campaign 4 so far.
Critical Role had an overwhelming number of shocking moments in its four-episode overture, so narrowing it down to one big thing was difficult.

The arrival of House Tachonis assassins at Palazzo Davinos and their brutal slaughter of the households of House Royce, Davinos, and Occtis Tachonis ( who, don’t worry, recovered) kept us on the edge of our seats from beginning to end. With the players still low-level, Critters unsure which player character would even survive into the next arc, and the constant reminder that “anyone could die,” this moment established a Game of Thrones -like tone that has persisted throughout the campaign.

The death of Thjazi Fang, the character who brought the 13 characters together in the first place, occurred after he got sold out by one of his old war buddies, Crow Keeper Casimir Gavendale. As a reward for his effort, he was granted the title of Baron of Sloak.

articles.title: Paradox's latest grand strategy Afterworld wants you to survive and thrive in the post-apocalypse
articles.summary: After a succession of grand strategy sequels - including Crusader Kings 3, Victoria 4, and Europa Universalis 5 - Paradox has unveiled Afterworld, its first grand strategy game to feature an original setting in over a decade.
body: As its name hints at, Afterworld whisks strategy fans to a post-apocalyptic future; specifically a post-apocalyptic North America blighted with hazardous terrain, dangerous old-world ruins, and the desperate remnants of humanity. Through this hostile, procedurally generated landscape, players must slowly grow a small group of survivors into a continent-spanning empire - by first scavenging food, water, and shelter, before rediscovering the basic methods of civilisation and expanding from there.

Paradox describes Afterworld as a "story rich" strategy game, beginning with players choosing one of several origin stories for their group - perhaps they've been forced to abandon a failed nuclear bunker, or are "wayward zealots looking for their goddess in the dustlands". Then as the group grows, they'll learn new skills and rediscover technologies (all unlocked dynamically based on what players find as they explore), set up convoys and supply lines, encounter rival groups, negotiate trades, and fight wars where necessary.

articles.title: After 25 Years, Sci-fi Cult Classic Donnie Darko is Officially Getting a Proper Sequel
articles.summary: Few movies have inspired as much late-night theorizing as Donnie Darko. Richard Kelly’s 2001 cult classic follows Donnie, a troubled teenager who begins seeing visions of Frank, a stranger in a sinister bunny costume who warns him that the world will end in 28 days.
body: Even after multiple viewings, Donnie Darko remains difficult to fully decode — and if anyone tells you they understand it fully, they're probably lying. That's part of why the film has maintained such a devoted following. Now, 25 years after the film’s release, Kelly is preparing to revisit that strange world.

As first reported by Variety, writer-director Richard Kelly is releasing a sequel book, The Philosophy of Time Travel, later this year. The approximately 800-page novel will be published by Range Literary Publishing and is expected to arrive in the fourth quarter, around the film’s 25th anniversary.

The book picks up 14 months after Donnie’s death and will be told through found documents, including material written from the perspectives of Donnie’s parents, Rose and Eddie. The story will follow the characters as they try to understand what happened to Donnie, the tangent universe and the strange events they collectively experienced.
points: Few movies have inspired as much late-night theorizing as Donnie Darko.

body: Remastered also sounds like a considerable effort. It's been co-developed with a studio called Yigsoft, and not only does it offer visual and performance enhancements but gameplay has been revamped too, including, yes, combat. There are new finishers, new animations, and an adaptive camera. The skill tree has also been reimagined to offer more flexibility, and there's a transmogrification system, "immersive meditation" according to The Witcher 3 website, an expanded photo mode, cross-platform mod support and more.

A trailer for Remastered showed "enhanced combat", "improved traversal and movement", "enhanced monster behaviours", "improved mount handling", as well as the new skill tree and transmog system for you gear, and some of the new finishers.
As well as all this, the two existing expansions for The Witcher 3 - Blood and Wine and Hearts of Stone - are also free for all owners of the base game as of this evening, too.

articles.title: Gears of War: E-Day somehow feels exactly like a direct continuation of the original Xbox 360 trilogy, for better and for worse
articles.summary: Marcus Fenix says something gruffly, his squad laughs, then a horde of Locust enemies rushes the team. The hulking figure of Marcus roadie-runs towards the nearest hip-high bit of cover, slams his muscly shoulder into the concrete, and starts laying down suppressing fire with his Lancer machine…
body: But this isn't a bad thing. Even the post-trilogy Gears games have never really lived up to the series' high - that initial, unlikely run of hits between 2006 and 2011. Since the heady days of the early 2010s, there's not been something so unashamedly silly as Gears to keep us occupied. The days of the co-op over-the-shoulder cover shooter seem confined to the Xbox 360 and PS3 era, as the FPS ate away at its popularity in the generations between.

If you managed to get some time with the E-Day beta, you'll know the bones are solid enough; the shooting is good, the cover mechanics are decent, and the cover-to-cover wall bouncing is as controversial as it ever was. Movement exploits and 'cheesing' are as divisive now as they were in the 2010s. And therein lies my assessment of the single-player mode, too, really: if you like Gears back then, you're going to like this. If you didn't, precious little has changed.

Players will become Noa, the Collector, who wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces.
Investigate during the day, and face your demons when the sun goes down.
